analysis.analysis: The overall conversion rate is 12.26%, which is significantly above the industry benchmark of 1.4% to 2.5%. This indicates that the landing pages and conversion processes are functioning effectively. However, the cost per customer varies widely across channels, with Google Ads, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and Email all showing higher costs compared to SMS. The high costs in these channels suggest that while the conversion rate is strong, the traffic costs are inflating the overall customer acquisition costs. Therefore, the primary bottleneck appears to be related to the cost of traffic rather than the conversion efficiency.

recommendations.title: Reallocate Budget to SMS and Email
recommendations.whats_happening: SMS and Email channels have the lowest cost per customer, yet receive only 9% of the total budget.
evidence: SMS cost-per-customer is $0.83 with 2.5% of budget
Email cost-per-customer is $1.47 with 6.1% of budget

what_you_should_do.step: Increase budget allocation to SMS and Email channels.
what_you_should_do.how: Shift budget from higher cost channels like TikTok and Instagram to SMS and Email.
guardrails: Ensure not to exceed the capacity of SMS and Email channels to handle increased volume.

recommendations.why_this_matters: By reallocating budget to more cost-effective channels, overall customer acquisition costs can be reduced, improving profitability.

expected_impact.explanation: Lowering budget allocation to high-cost channels and increasing it for low-cost channels will reduce the average cost per customer.

dependency_or_risk: Ensure SMS and Email channels can scale without diminishing returns.

measurement_plan.how_to_measure: Compare cost per customer before and after budget reallocation.
measurement_plan.success_criteria: Decrease in overall cost per customer by at least 10%.
measurement_plan.check_timing: Review after 2 weeks of budget reallocation.
measurement_plan.notes: Monitor for any diminishing returns on SMS and Email channels.

recommendations.title: Test New Creatives for TikTok and Instagram
recommendations.whats_happening: TikTok and Instagram have high costs per customer, indicating potential issues with ad effectiveness.

what_you_should_do.step: Develop and test new ad creatives.
what_you_should_do.how: Create multiple variations of ad creatives focusing on different messaging and visuals.
guardrails: Ensure new creatives align with brand guidelines and target audience preferences.

recommendations.why_this_matters: Improving ad effectiveness can reduce the cost per click and subsequently the cost per customer.

expected_impact.explanation: More effective ads should lead to higher engagement and lower cost per customer.

measurement_plan.how_to_measure: Track changes in cost per customer and engagement metrics for new creatives.
measurement_plan.success_criteria: Decrease in cost per customer by at least 15% on TikTok and Instagram.
measurement_plan.check_timing: Review after 4 weeks of running new creatives.
measurement_plan.notes: Consider seasonal effects on ad performance.

recommendations.title: Optimize Google Ads Bidding Strategy
recommendations.whats_happening: Google Ads has a relatively high cost per customer, suggesting inefficient bidding strategies.

what_you_should_do.step: Review and adjust bidding strategies to focus on high-performing keywords.
what_you_should_do.how: Analyze keyword performance and adjust bids to prioritize cost-effective keywords.

recommendations.why_this_matters: Optimizing bidding strategies can lower traffic costs, reducing the overall cost per customer.

expected_impact.explanation: More efficient bidding should reduce costs associated with acquiring customers.

measurement_plan.how_to_measure: Monitor changes in cost per customer and keyword performance metrics.
measurement_plan.success_criteria: Reduction in cost per customer by at least 10% on Google Ads.
measurement_plan.check_timing: Evaluate after 4 weeks of bidding adjustments.
measurement_plan.notes: Consider external factors affecting keyword performance.

recommendations.title: Increase Frequency of Email Campaigns
recommendations.whats_happening: Email has a low cost per customer but is underutilized in terms of budget allocation and frequency.

what_you_should_do.step: Increase the frequency of email campaigns to reach more potential customers.
what_you_should_do.how: Schedule additional email campaigns targeting different segments of the audience.
guardrails: Ensure email content remains relevant and engaging to avoid subscriber fatigue.

recommendations.why_this_matters: Increasing email frequency can leverage its low cost per customer to acquire more customers efficiently.

expected_impact.explanation: More frequent email campaigns should increase customer acquisition at a low cost.

measurement_plan.how_to_measure: Track changes in cost per customer and conversion rates from email campaigns.
measurement_plan.success_criteria: Increase in new customers acquired through email by 20%.
measurement_plan.check_timing: Assess after 2 weeks of increased email frequency.
measurement_plan.notes: Monitor unsubscribe rates to ensure content remains engaging.

recommendations.title: Conduct Audience Segmentation for Facebook
recommendations.whats_happening: Facebook has a high cost per customer, indicating potential misalignment with target audience.

what_you_should_do.step: Perform detailed audience segmentation to identify high-value segments.
what_you_should_do.how: Use demographic and behavioral data to refine audience targeting.
guardrails: Ensure segments are large enough to be statistically significant.

recommendations.why_this_matters: Better audience targeting can improve ad relevance and reduce acquisition costs.

expected_impact.explanation: Targeting more relevant audiences should increase conversion rates and reduce costs.

measurement_plan.how_to_measure: Compare cost per customer and conversion rates before and after segmentation.
measurement_plan.success_criteria: Reduction in cost per customer by 10% on Facebook.
measurement_plan.check_timing: Review after 6 weeks of implementing new targeting.
measurement_plan.notes: Consider potential changes in audience behavior over time.
